externals.notes: Free-tier route for ALL operations of this model. Each used_for entry names a delegated operation and its artifacts: type 'script' = a runnable in the external's stage folder (the launcher only resolves declared scripts); type 'result' = an output produced by the operation that lives Hub-side in the MODEL folder (<model>/<operation>/results.yaml, uploaded as .eval_results/<operation>.yaml). training: T4 kernels train from the staged train tar and push model + card to the Hub. evaluation: accuracy benchmark on the staged, unseen val split; publishes its card section. testing: batched-fp16 performance benchmark over the full test split (two staged halves; no public ground truth); publishes its card section. The dataset itself is already prepared on the Hub (Lekim89/sportsmot), so no data-preparation stage is delegated. Launched via run.sh / run.ps1.
